scope: Loose guided online copy tasks, linked to the existing Klink book-goal/lesson-plan guidance; no new course programme.
bookGoalEvidence: The learner types the same lowercase letter or word shown in the model, checks it and retains their first response and correction.
existingTeacherPlan: docs/KLINK-DOCENTHANDLEIDING.md: sections8 Schrijven of grammatica oefenen,10 Je les voorbereiden,11 Je les bekijken met het lesbezoekkader.
lessonPlanStatus: Existing15-minute model block and writing extension, to be selected within the actual group plan; not a scheduled new meeting.

observations.task: One visible lowercase letter/word is typed from its model.
observations.teacherAction: Model one typing/checking action; explain that uppercase and extra characters change the copy. At a, explain if needed that typography can vary while the same lowercase letter is requested; no font or handwriting matching is assessed.
observations.learnerBehaviour: Starts the intended task and points to the matching model.
observations.material: Existing book/word card plus current copy screen.

observations.sourceHeading: Actief oefenen en samenwerken; hulp en tempo
observations.task: Learners each type a model and correct their own response.
observations.teacherAction: Give thinking time and one specific clue; preserve the learner response instead of filling it in.
observations.learnerBehaviour: Types, checks and corrects; first and latest submissions remain available.
observations.material: Current online model/input and existing book or word card.

observations.task: Compare one first response and correction with the same model.
observations.teacherAction: Note what was copied and what help was used; choose the next task and real date in the actual plan.
observations.learnerBehaviour: Shows the corrected letter/word and identifies what changed.
observations.material: Stored own responses and existing teacher lesson-plan fields.

timeCounting: Within the existing selected lesson block; no duplicate minutes, prescribed homework, new hours variant or pause assumption.
openAtGroupLevel: real scheduled meeting and teacher time choice
